info.title: Aeyhey API
info.description: Generated from packages/core/src/api/manifest.ts by `pnpm api:spec`. Do not edit by hand. Apps sign in through /connect and send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; see docs/api.md.

savedAt.description: An ISO 8601 date and time, in UTC.

due.description: An ISO 8601 date and time, in UTC.

lifeLeft.description: How much of its life the link has left before it goes to Last chance, from 1 (just saved) to 0 (expired). It is the closest of the three expiry rules in the user's settings: times snoozed, sessions ignored, and days unread. A link on its Last chance reports 0.05. Null when the link does not expire: it is read or dropped, or the user has turned expiry off.

nextCursor.description: Pass back as `cursor` for the next page. Null when there is no more.

post.summary: Save links. Any text works: every URL in it is saved.

One message to the assistant. Links in it are saved; a request for questions comes back as a deck proposal to confirm through /question-sources/topics; a question is answered from the user's own library, with sources; anything ambiguous comes back with options to send again with force set.

One deck, its questions, its topics and when its next questions are written.

createdAt.description: An ISO 8601 date and time, in UTC.

progress.description: Where the question stands in spaced repetition. Null when it is suspended. When it is next asked is left out on purpose.

state.description: new: never asked. due: asked before and come round again. learning: next review under 21 days away. learned: spaced 21 days or more apart.

timesAsked.description: How many times it has been asked and answered.

lastAskedAt.description: When it was last asked, null if never.

lastAnswer.description: The user's latest written answer, from a review that still stands. Null when never answered in writing.

answeredAt.description: An ISO 8601 date and time, in UTC.

details.description: What the user wrote about this topic, used whenever its questions are written.

topics.description: The topics the deck is written from. Empty for resume, document and manual decks.

nextQuestionsLabel.description: When Aeyhey writes this deck's next questions, such as "Tomorrow at 09:00": just before the next reminder. Null when reminders are paused or the deck is not written by Aeyhey. New questions are only written once every question in the deck has been asked at least once.

patch.summary: Rename a deck, set its topic details, or pause and resume it. The links deck keeps its name.

paused.description: True pauses the deck: its questions are kept but not asked. False resumes it.

pausedAt.description: When the deck was paused, or null while it is asked.

createdAt.description: An ISO 8601 date and time, in UTC.

dueReview.description: Due again after being answered before.

learned.description: Questions the scheduler now spaces 21 days or more apart.

details.description: What the user wrote about this topic, used whenever its questions are written.

topics.description: The topics the deck is written from. Empty for resume, document and manual decks.

delete.summary: Delete a deck and its questions.
